note: Honest, overfitting-aware evaluation of the newly trained cities. The offset is fit on the TRAINING segment only, ties are broken on VALIDATION, and the selected offset is evaluated UNTOUCHED on HOLDOUT. Holdout figures are the out-of-sample estimate; the shipped offset is refit on all dates and its full-dataset figures are labelled inSample.
caveat: This dataset is a single 30-day SUMMER window (2026-06-17..2026-07-16). These figures are NOT a claim of annual or year-round accuracy.

split.rule: first two-thirds training, next one-sixth validation, final one-sixth holdout
